preserves: S11 v0.1 fixed-amplitude charter as baseline
decision: do not freeze or implement until direct-competitor full-text gate and short-history moment gate pass
research_target: Time-uniform attack-trajectory confidence under a trusted pre-attack event and finite-bit post-event payload channel, connected to full-record posterior-risk decisions.

proposed_one_switch.schedule: zero before k0; b1 on [k0,s); b2 on [s,k1); zero after k1
proposed_one_switch.amplitude_path: fixed deterministically before observation generation; no current-innovation-adaptive b_t

proposed_reference_prior.switch_time_weights: uniform over s satisfying both segment lengths >=5
proposed_reference_prior.pair_rule: for one-switch templates require |b2-b1|<=0.25; normalize uniformly over admissible ordered pairs
proposed_reference_prior.status: candidate normalized mixture; prior mass and endpoint conventions require proof before implementation

audit_candidate.observation: trusted event and finite saturating payload code
audit_candidate.confidence: fixed-trajectory time-uniform likelihood-ratio confidence set with normalized onset/duration/switch/reference-amplitude mixture
audit_candidate.coverage_claim: for each fixed admissible true trajectory; no blanket simultaneous coverage over all continuous trajectories
audit_candidate.box_exclusion: certified likelihood upper for whole box below epsilon times certified reference-process lower

fusion_candidate.posterior_moments: outer bounds on unnormalized mass, first state moment, and second state moment
fusion_candidate.objective: minimize certified worst-case full-record conditional squared risk over surviving trajectory boxes plus health
fusion_candidate.benchmark: global ML single-model posterior mean on exactly the same record
fusion_candidate.claim_scope: worst-case conditional-risk control only; expected post-stop MSE improvement requires a separate paired experiment
fusion_candidate.ml_inclusion_fact: if R_t is a mixture over the same candidate class and 0<epsilon<1, a global ML candidate satisfies L_ML>=R_t>epsilon*R_t and remains in the confidence set
fusion_candidate.consequence: confidence-set fusion is a worst-case action over plausible models, not an assurance that the ML model is wrong or can be removed

novelty_status.time_varying_attack_estimation: covered by close prior work; not a contribution
novelty_status.feasible_attack_history_set: covered broadly by set-membership and interval-observer work; not a contribution
novelty_status.quantized_attack_compensation: multiple close prior works; not a contribution
novelty_status.piecewise_constant_amplitude: a bounded modeling stress only; TIFS 2018 studies unknown time-varying attack vectors and TIFS 2019 reports online estimation of unknown time-varying attack parameters with state recovery
novelty_status.finite_bit_joint_event_code_time_uniform: candidate gap, open pending full-text comparison and a demonstrated nontrivial risk result

gates_before_implementation: complete full-text equation-level comparison for TIFS 2018 and 2019, Automatica 2022, IEEE Sensors Journal 2024, IEEE TSIPN 2026, and Ad Hoc Networks 2026
derive the one-switch finite-code recursion and normalized reference process
prove a nondegenerate posterior-risk or worst-case-regret result
verify a 2-5 step full-history moment outer enclosure for a switch-crossing record
